description: This file defines a Flutter widget named SwipeDeck, which presents a deck of cards that can be swiped with like/dislike actions. It includes UI buttons for liking or disliking the current card and manages the display of cards in a stack.

classes.name: SwipeDeck
classes.description: A minimal swipe deck widget with like and dislike callbacks.

classes.name: _SwipeDeckState
classes.description: State class managing the current index and swipe actions inside the SwipeDeck widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget.

methods.name: _like
methods.description: Handler for the like button, invokes callback and moves to the next card.

methods.name: _dislike
methods.description: Handler for the dislike button, invokes callback and moves to the next card.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's UI, displaying the current card or a message if no more cards.
